name: 27932 · Edenton, NC
findings: ZIP 27932 (Edenton) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27932 (Edenton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27932 (Edenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
